grade_definitions.LOCAL_KERNEL_SCOPE: Local Lean-compiled mathematical core, but the dissertation's displayed normalization or scope is not a separate exact-type terminal declaration.
grade_definitions.EXTERNAL_KERNEL_SCOPE: Previously published third-party Lean theorem is imported/cited; dissertation presentation has an uncompiled translation of conventions.
grade_definitions.SCOPED_COMPONENTS: One or more named Lean subtheorems are compiled; essential hypothesis/representation/composition bridge remains uncompiled.
grade_definitions.FINITE_CHECK_ONLY: Mathematical argument is written and finite examples may be checked; no universal Lean theorem for the claim.
grade_definitions.ANALYTIC_ONLY: Mathematical argument/proof is written or classical, with no identified claim-specific Lean compiler receipt.

1,414 exact convolution assertions are reported in PDF Appendix B without a verified source script/CI receipt in inspected repository paths. Do not promote that numerical count as independently reproduced.
Zero source-level universal claims are promoted from subtheorem or finite checker by this ledger. This is an accounting artifact, not an end-to-end proof.

The PDF reports 123 adaptive-policy, 161 live-query and six evaluation-span tests from check_joint_frontier_exact.py, which is not in the current repository.
